This scene:
古代的时候，有一个男孩名字叫孟子。孟子和孟子的妈妈两个人住在很穷的农村。他们住的地方旁边是个墓地，墓地老是有很多人祭拜。因为人们在祭拜，他们一直在哭。孟子和孟子的妈妈住在这里才一个星期就觉得受不了了，而且害得孟子的学习。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候：在古代
- 而且害得孟子的学习：害得孟子的学习不好，害得 + harmful result

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，The original repeats two time expressions with the same meaning; use the shorter time phrase. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 有一个男孩名字叫孟子：有一个叫孟子的男孩，Place the name phrase before the noun to introduce the character clearly as both a boy and the person named孟子. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 而且害得孟子的学习：而且影响了孟子的学习，害得 must be followed by a person and a harmful result clause; it cannot directly take a noun phrase such as孟子的学习. [teacher rule: haide_structure]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟子的妈妈两个人：孟子和妈妈两个人，Within the same clause, do not repeat the name inside the possessive phrase; zero form is natural when the relationship is already clear. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟子的妈妈住在这里：孟子和妈妈住在这里，Within the same clause, omit the repeated name in the possessive phrase because the mother has already been identified. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
6. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 住在这里才一个星期就觉得受不了了：才在这里住了一个星期，就觉得受不了了，The one-week stay is completed before the later feeling, so use了 after住; the duration follows the verb. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
7. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 因为人们在祭拜，他们一直在哭：因为人们在祭拜，所以他们一直在哭，A cause-and-effect relationship needs the paired connector因为……所以…… . [rule: none]

items.reason: “古代的时候” redundantly combines two time expressions, and “在古代” is correct.
“有一个男孩名字叫孟子” is already grammatical and clearly introduces the character.
“害得” cannot directly take “孟子的学习” as its object, while “影响了孟子的学习” is grammatical.
“孟子和孟子的妈妈两个人” is a natural and unambiguous way to identify Mencius and his mother.
Repeating “孟子” in “孟子和孟子的妈妈” is grammatical and does not create a reference error.
The one-week stay is a completed duration before the feeling of being unable to bear it, so “住了一个星期” is required.
Under the teacher's required paired-connector rule, “因为” needs “所以” here.
